create_GNet_generator: create a GNet generator network with a latent vector dimension and output channels for DCGAN image generation
create_DNet_discriminator: create a DNet discriminator network with input channels and decision layer size for DCGAN image classification
run_GNet_forward: run the GNet forward pass to generate images from a latent vector input tensor
run_DNet_forward: run the DNet forward pass to classify input images and optionally extract feature maps
apply_weights_init: apply the weights_init function to initialize Conv and BatchNorm layer weights with normal distribution
